The company operates with a 6,000-strong team across 61 offices worldwide, providing multidisciplinary expertise and consistent standards. The engineer will perform detailed calculations, prepare specifications, assess mechanical system layouts, and coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure compliance with technical standards and client requirements.
